# osapi nats auth

Make the NATS authentication of osapi, a credential for each role.
`osapi dsl command get --name nats auth` shows the same.

## Group

|             |                                                                   |
| ----------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Name        | nats auth                                                         |
| Description | Make the NATS authentication of osapi, a credential for each role |

## [osapi nats auth password create](../../usage/cli/nats/auth/password/create.md)

|             |                                                       |
| ----------- | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| Method      | password create                                       |
| Description | Make a user and a random password for each osapi role |
| Refuses     | no directory                                          |

### Flags (2)

| FLAG    | TYPE   | VALIDATE  | HELP                                                                            |
| ------- | ------ | --------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| --out   | string | required  | The directory that the files go to. It is made, mode 0700, when it is not there |
| --print | bool   | omitempty | Also print the server's part: its authorization block, or its resolver file     |
